svg.aria-label: BAP-MOS framework. (A) Outer loop: a TPE sampler searches the prompt-selection parameters and proposes a candidate vector. (B) Inner loop: (1) per-organ UCB-Tuned prompt selector, (2) organ-scaled prompt geometry from ground-truth masks, (3) segmentation model with frozen image and prompt encoders and a trainable mask decoder, (4) boundary-sensitive composite reward from Dice, MSD and HD95 that updates the selector.
svg.text: one candidate per trial, scored by a full inner-loop run
UCB score per action · each choice held for K batches
turns the chosen action into prompts

g.text: Ring width grows with organ size

svg.text: validation probe after every K batches
bounded in [0, 1]; distances clipped at τ and 3τ
computed per organ for the action it used
